page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Large title block at the top, centred; below it a short block in smaller type ("in quibus"); then a small device between rules; a publisher line at the foot. Some mirrored show-through from the reverse is visible in the middle and is left out.
page.notes: Scan is faded and largely unreadable; the title lines are reconstructed only in part. Lines marked [illegible] could not be read letter by letter. The lowest line, with a date and place, is too faint to read. The central device between the rules is an engraved or printed ornament, not text. Show-through from the reverse side is present in the middle of the page and was not transcribed.
